text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The New Year. Marvelous Sunday steps up 
to the Classic Year starting this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While spending the New Year holidays 
relaxing and thinking about our 
breakthroughs for the new year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadada—bam!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer☆ H-A-P-P-Y Marve-looous★ Look at 
the TV! Look at the TV!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even get to give New Year's 
greetings. And what's worse, the hottest 
topic right now is probably—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Across the finish line!! Taking the 
victory is Fuji Kiseki, three consecutive 
wins since her debut!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Next year's Classic will most likely 
revolve around her—!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has taken the lead! Narita 
Brian is in front!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Strong, so strong! Narita Brian! With an 
astonishing run, she claims victory in the 
Arima Kinen! She has achieved the Classic 
Quadruple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fuji and Brian are both so amazing!! Since 
last year, the TV and magazines have been 
all about the two of them!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to race in the same era as two 
such amazing girls is a true miracle, 
isn't it? Marvelous☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"During the Classics, I wanna be just as 
marvelous as those two☆ So without further 
ado—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Training, let's gooo!
choice_data_list: Wait, it's still New Year's Day—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably, they couldn't be stopped in 
time. After watching Marvelous Sunday 
blast down the track like that for a 
moment—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, ahahahahaha—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *pant*... ahaha... *wheeze*.
choice_data_list:
Good work today... Wait, aren't you more 
tired than usual?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't help it... I ran all the 
way back from my parents' house... *pant* 
*gasp*.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's right! But don't worry☆ I'm so 
filled with Marvelous that I can still run 
a whole lot more★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There was no way he was fine. If he was 
commuting all the way from his family 
home, it wasn't just a matter of a stop or 
two—it was clear overwork."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, excited by her rivals' 
performances, Marvelous Sunday seemed 
completely unable to hit the brakes on 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't let her keep running any longer. 
In order to stop this—
choice_data_list:
Why not enjoy some New Year's Marvelous 
next?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's Marvelous? What's that, 
sounds fun! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Since she seemed willing to play along, I 
decided to press the advantage. An eye for 
an eye, marvelous for marvelous. If I want 
to win her heart—"
choice_data_list:
Let's pour our souls into every stroke and 
write our aspirations for the new year!

How about filling both your heart and 
stomach with some mochi pounding?

When it comes to New Year's, there's only 
one classic game to play!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see, the year's first 
calligraphy! In that case, I've got a 
great idea! Trainer, follow me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, for some reason right in front of 
the dorms, Marvelous Sunday briskly 
carried on with preparations—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Calligraphy paper, check! Giant brush, 
check! Bucket of ink, check!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainer, back me up with some 
cheers☆ Here we gooo★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice, under the clear blue sky—! Here 
is my official report—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I can even process her sudden, 
grand proclamation, Marvelous Sunday 
readies a giant calligraphy brush almost 
reaching up to her chest.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Reeeady, go, MARVELOUS!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I chimed in on impulse, the dorm 
residents began poking their heads out of 
the windows one after another, as if drawn 
by the sound.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaarvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Is that Marvelous-senpai? I think this 
might be my first time seeing a 
calligraphy performance!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Going at it right from New Year's Day?! 
Talk about fired up!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And with thiiis... it's finiiished! ☆★ 
Marveeelooous! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah!! *Clap, clap, clap!!*)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you for your marvelous 
cheering--!!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-senpai! That was amazing to 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chan, your handwriting is amazing!! 
Write something else for me next time!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gallery, which had swelled into a 
massive crowd before anyone noticed, gave 
an ink-covered Marvelous Sunday a generous 
round of applause.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt a refreshed mindset fitting for the 
new year. Looking at the bold calligraphy 
reading "Make the world Marvelous!", I 
resolved to support her by her side this 
year as well—!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay, mochi! Stretchy and yummy—it's 
marvelous, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them continued their 
preparations for making mochi—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Mhm, mhm! So for mochi pounding, you 
split into the pounder and the turner☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If we're not in sync, we might get hurt, 
right? But with you and me, Trainer, I 
know we'll be totally fine! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I strike! Trainer returns! When we're in 
sync, it's marvelous☆ Here it comes, super 
fast--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I wondered what all the ruckus was 
about! Pounding mochi with just the two of 
you? I'm impressed!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amaaa!! Happy New Marvelous☆ What's 
up, did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, just doing the rounds! Checking if 
there's anyone looking lonely 'cause they 
couldn't head home for New Year's!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Glad to see you guys having fun! —Oh, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Could I ask you something? Would you mind 
letting a few of us help out with the 
mochi pounding?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It'd be a huge task for just the two of 
you, and I want those guys who can't go 
home to get a little taste of New Year's, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You mean we get to pound mochi together 
with everyone!? That is so very 
marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'll go talk to them right away☆ 
Mochi-mochi★ Tsuki-tsuki☆ Marveleeess★☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Happy New Year! I heard you guys were 
doing something fun?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations~! Please let us join in 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"You called on LANE so here I am☆ Maya, 
you see~ loves mochi♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, starting the New Year so lively 
makes me happy♪ Everyone, let's have a 
great year together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Marvelous Sunday called out to 
as many people as she could think of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, together with the students who 
gathered one after another, we enjoyed a 
lively mochi-pounding event!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then!? What do you play in 
these classic party games?
choice_data_list:
Of course it's the "Umamusume Game of 
Life"!

Of course it's the "Umamusume Game of 
Life"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each player becomes an Umamusume and 
follows the roll of the dice through 
various life events from childhood to 
adulthood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The game features randomly branching paths 
that lead to completely different futures.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, playing with you is so much fun, 
Trainer☆ Alright alright, first up is me—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A 6! 'Prefers books to running. Stuck in 
the library, lose one turn'!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"So fun! What other squares are there? 
'Became a Triple Crown Umamusume!' 
'Switched to the Sprint/Mile route!'"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Off to grad school to study starfish!" 
"Became an adventurer and unearthed 
out-of-place artifacts!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see, a future where I don't run is an 
option too! Uncharted possibilities are so 
marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Goooal! Ahaha, instead of racing, I ended 
up becoming a baker! Fluffy white bread, 
simply marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing too, Trainer! "14-win 
undefeated GⅠ champion" and "Legendary 
Umamusume"? Woah!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"This just proves that if you were born an 
Umamusume, it would've been totally 
marvelous, Trainer!☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
No, this is a story about a world that 
could have been! Believing in it is what 
makes it Marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, just imagining it made my heart 
race. Marvelous Sunday and I spent some 
time enjoying talking about a world other 
than this one.
